verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible banner layout: book on the left, headline in the centre and copy on the right. Both share the same flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the corner, the 'See the Schedule' CTA is a tiny pill that is easily missed, and the legal text beside it is unreadably small. A wraps the body copy into four even lines, while B's wrap ends on a short 'all night.' line. That is a hair worse, though otherwise the two are nearly identical.
